caption.text:
If I could search every corner of the universe… 🌎✨🌙

Every star.
Every galaxy.
Every once-in-a-lifetime chance.

I’d still come back to you. ❤️

Because some people are beautiful.
Some people are rare.
And then there’s that one person who feels like home no matter where life takes you.

For me, that’s you. 🥹💕

Tag the person you’d choose over and over again, in every lifetime and every universe. ❤️👇

#PassionateLoveMessages #LoveQuotes #RelationshipGoals #Soulmate #ILoveYou
